== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chris Gogolen]] (blue-and-grey raglan and a dark mask; same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship between rounds 2.jpg]]). Remaining: the opponent in an olive button-down shirt (same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship game in progress 8.jpg]]).

A game in progress. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:08 00:33:38 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-19
* '''Identification:''' [[Chris Gogolen]] (blue-and-grey raglan and a dark mask; same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship between rounds 2.jpg]]). Remaining: the opponent in an olive button-down shirt (same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship game in progress 8.jpg]]).
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
